hero.title: Investment Management
hero.subtitle: Whole-of-portfolio management for HNW families, built on a yield-plus philosophy and a single transparent fee.

statement.title: Institutional-grade portfolio management for family capital.
points: Portfolios are built from the ground up on income-producing securities, with growth assets added incrementally only where a higher return objective calls for it. With rates now higher, only a modest step up in credit risk is needed to reach long-term balanced-fund returns.

One discretionary mandate across Australian and global equities, fixed income, property, alternatives and cash. Asset allocation is made largely through ETFs: we select markets and themes rather than layering in external managers and their fees.
A single 0.20% p.a. service fee on the portfolio, capped at $200,000. Where capital sits in Arculus's own funds, the Arculus management fee inside the fund is waived.
statement.footnote: Terms are indicative and confirmed in the Investment Management Agreement

about.title: About the service
paragraphs: Arculus Investment Management provides discretionary, multi-asset management of a family's entire investment portfolio under a single Investment Management Agreement. Fixed income decisions sit with the same Investment Committee that runs the Arculus funds, so one philosophy applies across funds and family portfolios.

Assets are held with an independent custodian on a low-cost platform, with consolidated performance, holdings and tax reporting through a central portal. We work alongside your accountant. For structuring, endowment or estate advice, you keep your own advisers.

atAGlance.title: At a glance
atAGlance.note: Terms are indicative and confirmed in the Investment Management Agreement.
items: Nil platform fee; transactions at 0.10%, no rebates to Arculus
Waived on allocations to Arculus's own funds

howWeBuild.title: How we build portfolios
items: Return targets are met by stepping up risk incrementally from an income core, not by overweighting growth assets.
A choice of six expected-return models, from income-only to growth-tilted, agreed and documented in the IMA.
Used to manage risk, protect gains and optimise franking-credit capture, including protected equity positions.
Assets are held by an independent custodian and reconciled daily. Arculus never holds client money.

keyRisks.title: Key risks
paragraphs: Discretionary management carries market, credit and liquidity risk across every asset class held. Where derivatives or leverage are used, gains and losses are magnified. Capital is not guaranteed and past performance is not a reliable indicator of future performance.

Allocations to Arculus's own funds are a related-party arrangement. The fee waiver removes any incentive to over-allocate, and every allocation is documented, disclosed in the IMA and overseen by the Investment Committee.

cta.title: Talk to us about your family's portfolio
cta.body: Enquiries go directly to the portfolio management team. The first conversation is about your objectives, your structure and your accountant, not a product.
